name: budget_variance
description: Line items from a budget analysis report comparing a prior-year budget, a prior-year reforecast and the new budget. One row per detail line with a GL code. Section headers and total rows are not rows.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.description: Property name from the report header. Same for every row.

property_rsf.name: Property RSF
property_rsf.description: Property rentable square footage from the header, as a number. Same for every row.

budget_year.name: Budget Year
budget_year.description: The year of the new budget being analysed, as a four-digit number. Same for every row.

gl_code.name: GL Code
gl_code.description: General ledger account code of the line, exactly as shown, e.g. 6101-0000. One per row.

line_item.name: Line Item
line_item.description: Account name of the line exactly as shown.

section.name: Section
section.description: The nearest bold section header above the line, e.g. 'Rent Revenue', 'Cleaning Expenses'. Exactly as shown.

prior_year_budget.name: Prior Year Budget
prior_year_budget.description: The line's value in the prior-year budget column, as a number.

prior_year_reforecast.name: Prior Year Reforecast
prior_year_reforecast.description: The line's value in the prior-year reforecast column, as a number.

budget.name: Budget
budget.description: The line's value in the new budget column, as a number.

reforecast_vs_prior_budget_variance.name: Reforecast vs Prior Budget (amount)
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_variance.description: Dollar variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget, as a number with its sign as printed.

reforecast_vs_prior_budget_pct.name: Reforecast vs Prior Budget (%)
reforecast_vs_prior_budget_pct.description: Percentage variance of the prior-year reforecast against the prior-year budget, as a number exactly as printed, e.g. -46.78. null when the report prints N/A.

budget_vs_reforecast_variance.name: Budget vs Reforecast (amount)
budget_vs_reforecast_variance.description: Dollar variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast, as a number with its sign as printed.

budget_vs_reforecast_pct.name: Budget vs Reforecast (%)
budget_vs_reforecast_pct.description: Percentage variance of the new budget against the prior-year reforecast, as a number exactly as printed. null when the report prints N/A.

explanation_of_variance.name: Explanation of Variance
explanation_of_variance.description: The management commentary printed in the Explanation of Variance column for this line, verbatim. null if the column is empty for the line.
